meta.name: web3-testing
meta.description: Test smart contracts comprehensively using Hardhat and Foundry with unit tests, integration tests, and mainnet forking. Use when testing Solidity contracts, setting up blockchain test suites, or validating DeFi protocols.

copy.tagline: 用主网分叉全面测试智能合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在发布去中心化金融协议前需要全面检查合约行为
copy.tagline_en: Test smart contracts thoroughly with mainnet forking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build DeFi protocols and need automated contract tests before launch.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Hardhat 和 Foundry 的写法帮你编写和检查 Solidity 合约测试,涵盖单元测试、集成测试、gas 优化测试、模糊测试和主网分叉测试,并给出对应配置与代码模板。
howto.when: 当你要测试 Solidity 合约、搭建区块链测试套件或验证 DeFi 协议时触发。

say.text: 帮我的 Solidity 合约写一套 Hardhat 单元测试
say.note: 会给出 fixture 和断言示例

say.text: 给这个 ERC20 合约加一个 Foundry 模糊测试
用主网分叉测一下这个 DeFi 合约的交互
say.note: 会配置 fork 并连接主网合约

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes and reviews Solidity contract tests in Hardhat and Foundry style: unit, integration, gas optimization, fuzz and mainnet fork tests, with matching config and templates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you test Solidity contracts, set up blockchain test suites, or validate DeFi protocols.

say_en.text: Write a Hardhat unit test suite for my Solidity contract
Add a Foundry fuzz test for this ERC20 contract
Test this DeFi contract against a mainnet fork
say_en.note: Configures the fork and mainnet contracts
